mutations.name: the sweep never reads deploy-window.json
kills: serve's deploy pacer sweep keeps a wanted sha the running build descends from while deploy-window.json shows that build still in its health watch

mutations.name: /health reads no wait the sweep wrote
kills: serve's deploy pacer sweep spawns the deployer once for a queued sha after the quiet window, and /health shows it pending, then spawned

mutations.name: an ask whose own run did not fail reads as green
kills: the deploy pacer reads the asked sha's own main CI run (TP-4279) falls back to the newest older green sha when the asked sha's own run is in progress after a failed parent
the deploy pacer reads the asked sha's own main CI run (TP-4279) falls back to the newest older green sha when the asked sha's own run is cancelled
the deploy pacer reads the asked sha's own main CI run (TP-4279) falls back to the newest older green sha when the asked sha's own run is skipped
the deploy pacer reads the asked sha's own main CI run (TP-4279) deploys the last green sha, never the asked one, when the asked sha's run was cancelled

mutations.name: a fallback whose newest run did not succeed is taken on an older success
kills: the deploy pacer reads the asked sha's own main CI run (TP-4279) skips a fallback whose own newest run did not succeed, and a green run listed newer than the asked sha
